messages.subject: R  inside Qt
parts:
Hi,
I would like to create Application using Qt library. The application consists to R script that ask some input file and return outputs.

Is there a way (plugin for Qt) which allows me to include R code into Qt Widget project?

Thanks
Karim

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Re: R  inside Qt
parts:
This really hasn't anything to do with shiny, but yes, you can create GUI's using Qt that runs R code. The package you are looking for is qtbase. You have to build it yourself though...

best

Thomas
